stories.title: A dense 3D landscape, built from basic geometry and displacement
stories.blurb: Calder Moore walks through a fantasy scene from thumbnail sketch to Photoshop paint-over. The reusable moves: lock the camera early and build to that shot, let displacement textures carry the detail on simple geometry, desaturate to check values, render Z-depth, bloom and object-ID passes, and add grain at the end to lose the 3D look.

sources.name: Creative Bloq
sources.headline: How to make a detailed 3D landscape using Photoshop, Cinema 4D and ZBrush

stories.title: Cut the portfolio deck to the slides that prove a decision
stories.blurb: Marina Krutchinsky took a Staff designer's Director-panel deck from 41 slides to 10 with one test: which decision of mine does this slide prove? Slides without a decision, such as research grids, process diagrams and timelines, move to an appendix and come back as answers when the panel asks.

sources.name: Marina Krutchinsky
sources.headline: How to cut your panel presentation down to the slides that get you hired
sources.author: Marina Krutchinsky

stories.title: GTA VI advertises its world through fake brands
stories.blurb: Alongside the key art, Rockstar runs billboards and kiosk ads in Miami for in-game parody brands, with only a small logo and QR code pointing back to the game. Creative Bloq's reading: the ads sell the game's satirical tone without showing gameplay, puzzle newcomers into talking, and work as inside jokes for long-time players.

sources.name: Creative Bloq
sources.headline: The cleverest GTA VI adverts don't even show the game

stories.title: Junior design roles down 81% at one recruiter, and 25 views on what follows
stories.blurb: Represent worked on 118 junior roles in 2016 and 22 so far this year. Creative Lives in Progress asked 25 studio owners, recruiters and educators what comes next: several expect a correction once talent pipelines dry up, others warn that routes bypassing education will favour people with money and connections.

sources.name: It's Nice That
sources.headline: Starting a creative career has never felt harder – 28 industry voices on what comes next

stories.title: Suno sued under Tennessee's voice-cloning law
stories.blurb: Elvis Presley's rights holders and an Eminem publisher have filed two more suits against Suno; the Presley complaint invokes the ELVIS Act, which bans AI cloning of a singer's voice. Like the Isbell case in September, the claims target imitation of artists rather than copyright directly.

sources.name: The Verge
sources.headline: Elvis and Eminem rights holders are suing Suno
